segments.t: Five minutes and three confident turns later, Manager Zhou rounds a sunny brick corner expecting the municipal clock tower—and stops right underneath the open cafe window of Courtyard Inn, where Mei is dusting warm rolls with cinnamon. Listen first.
哈！瞧这面安静的老砖墙——我们肯定就在钟楼广场后面！
老板，早上又见啦！您是忘带钱包了，还是想我啦？
小美？！你怎么站在市政钟楼后面的窗户里面呀？！
因为往左拐三次就是一圈，周经理，这是我们自己的厨房窗户！
等等——您不会又没戴老花镜，走了那条著名的巷子近路吧！
明明是去年春天以后，有人把那个绿花园栅栏搬走了！
往好处想呀：绕圈探险的时候，大家肯定不会饿肚子！
来，拿着纸袋里三个热乎乎的肉桂卷，再去试试吧！
谢谢小美，这件事千万别跟老陈提半个字呀！
放心，我一定保密，只要您从这儿跟着志豪和黄铜指南针走！
一言为定！周经理，中午十二点敲响以前，快把地图卡片交出来归我们指挥吧！
好吧，顺着梧桐巷往上走——我刚才只是考验你们的方向感！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
哈！瞧这面安静的老砖墙——我们肯定就在钟楼广场后面！

'Aha! Behold this quiet historic wall—we must be right behind the clock square!' Broad flat surfaces like walls and mirrors take "mian", "face", as their counter: "zhe mian lao zhuanqiang", "this old brick wall".
老板，早上又见啦！您是忘带钱包了，还是想我啦？

'Good morning again, boss! Did you forget your wallet, or did you miss me?' Everyday "xiang" shifts meaning by what follows: before an action it means "want to", while in "xiang wo" it means "miss me"!
小美？！你怎么站在市政钟楼后面的窗户里面呀？！
'Mei?! Why are you standing inside a window behind the municipal clock tower?!' Putting "zenme" ahead of an action asks an astonished "how come?", capturing Manager Zhou's total disbelief.
因为往左拐三次就是一圈，周经理，这是我们自己的厨房窗户！

'Because three left turns make a circle, Manager Zhou, and this is our own kitchen window!' "Sanci" counts "three times" right after the action "guai", "turn", and "women ziji de" stresses "our very own".
等等——您不会又没戴老花镜，走了那条著名的巷子近路吧！

'Wait—tell me you took your famous back-alley shortcut without your glasses again!' Framing a guess with "buhui... ba" means "don't tell me you... again!", and Mandarin uses "dai" for wearing glasses or hats.
明明是去年春天以后，有人把那个绿花园栅栏搬走了！
'Someone clearly moved that green garden fence since last spring!' Leading with "mingming" insists "clearly" or "obviously" when making an excuse, and "ban zou" means "moved away".
往好处想呀：绕圈探险的时候，大家肯定不会饿肚子！
'Look on the bright side: nobody gets hungry on a circular expedition!' "Wang haochu xiang" literally says "think toward the good side"—"look on the bright side"—and "e duzi" means going hungry.
来，拿着纸袋里三个热乎乎的肉桂卷，再去试试吧！
'Here, take three warm cinnamon rolls in a paper bag before you try again.' "Rehuhu" tacks reduplicated "huhu" onto "re", "hot", for cosy bakery warmth on fresh "rouguijuan", cinnamon rolls.
谢谢小美，这件事千万别跟老陈提半个字呀！
'Thank you, Mei, and please do not mention a single word of this to Chen.' Urgent "qianwan bie" means "whatever you do, don't", while "ban ge zi" exaggerates "not even half a character"!
放心，我一定保密，只要您从这儿跟着志豪和黄铜指南针走！
'My lips are sealed, provided you follow Hao and the brass compass from here!' "Baomi" pairs "guard" and "secret" for keeping mum, while "zhiyao" introduces the condition "as long as".
一言为定！周经理，中午十二点敲响以前，快把地图卡片交出来归我们指挥吧！
'Deal! Hand over command of the map cards, Manager Zhou, before twelve noon strikes!' four-syllable "yiyanweiding" literally says "one word makes it settled"—Mandarin's crisp handshake for "deal!".
好吧，顺着梧桐巷往上走——我刚才只是考验你们的方向感！

'Very well, walk straight up Wutong Lane—I was merely testing your sense of direction!' "Zhishi" downplays an action as "merely", and adding "gan", "feeling", onto "fangxiang" creates "sense of direction".
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
哈！瞧这面安静的老砖墙——我们肯定就在钟楼广场后面！

因为往左拐三次就是一圈，周经理，这是我们自己的厨房窗户！
等等——您不会又没戴老花镜，走了那条著名的巷子近路吧！
明明是去年春天以后，有人把那个绿花园栅栏搬走了！
往好处想呀：绕圈探险的时候，大家肯定不会饿肚子！
来，拿着纸袋里三个热乎乎的肉桂卷，再去试试吧！
谢谢小美，这件事千万别跟老陈提半个字呀！
放心，我一定保密，只要您从这儿跟着志豪和黄铜指南针走！
一言为定！周经理，中午十二点敲响以前，快把地图卡片交出来归我们指挥吧！
好吧，顺着梧桐巷往上走——我刚才只是考验你们的方向感！
Armed with warm cinnamon rolls and humble pie, the crew sets off again—this time following the brass compass up Wutong Lane. See you next time.
回头见！
